視.meaning: A night-shift <part>lamppost</part> gets bored and borrows a tourist's <part>camera</part>. It zooms in on every passing dog, checking collars, paws and the shine on each nose, and jots notes in the dark. Every pup gets a full <kanji>inspection</kanji>.
視.on: A poodle that fails hides behind a knight's <sound>shi</sound>eld until morning.
視.kun: 'Check <sound>me</sound> next!' yaps a puppy, sitting up straight under the light.

都.meaning: <part>Someone</part> in a hat sticks a <part>pennant</part> into a muddy field and whistles. Pop: a skyscraper shoots up. Another pennant, another tower, then trains, traffic and pigeons. By supper the field is a roaring <kanji>metropolis</kanji>.
都.on: Right in the middle stands a <sound>to</sound>tem pole taller than every skyscraper.
都.kun: 'Look at <sound>me</sound>!' shouts the mayor from the rail <sound>ya</sound>rd, waving a sleepy <sound>ko</sound>ala at the crowds.

際.meaning: Grandma keeps a <part>pennant</part> folded in a drawer and flies it for only one strange <part>ritual</part>: the day her tortoise finally wakes up from its winter sleep. Then the whole street dances round the shell in pyjamas. It's a rare <kanji>occasion</kanji>.
際.on: Everyone raises a mug of warm apple <sound>ci</sound>der to the yawning tortoise.
際.kun: A <sound>ki</sound>wi bird peeps out from the edge of the lawn: '<sound>Wah</sound>!'

並.meaning: A goat with little <part>horns</part> is in charge of a birthday party. It sets the <part>candles</part> on <part>one</part> long plank, then butts any that wobble out of place, until all hundred stand neatly side by side in a perfect <kanji>row</kanji>.
並.on: Then it munches the whole bale of <sound>hay</sound> it was given as a party present.
並.kun: The guests bring <sound>na</sound>an bread, every piece the same, nothing special: just average.

軽.meaning: A <part>tumbleweed</part> rolls across the desert and bumps into a parked <part>car</part>, and the car blows away with it, bouncing like a beach ball. It turns out to be made of paper. Off it drifts, skipping over the dunes <kanji>lightly</kanji>.
軽.on: Inside the paper car sits a birthday <sound>ca</sound>ke that floats up the moment the door opens.
軽.kun: One <sound>ca</sound>lm puff of wind lifts it again, along with a <sound>ru</sound>by ring left on the seat.

固.meaning: An <part>old</part> loaf of bread sits forgotten in a bird <part>cage</part> for a whole year. When the parrot finally pecks it, its beak bounces off with a clang. The baker uses it as a doorstop now: leave anything long enough and it will <kanji>harden</kanji>.
固.on: A <sound>ko</sound>ala borrows the loaf to crack nuts on.
固.kun: A <sound>ca</sound>rp tries to nibble it too, then gives up and eats a <sound>ta</sound>co instead.
